pages.notes:
All five figures are done and are in the page. The lint of the page gives 0 findings. The page had no old figures, so no figure was replaced. Each figure has one new short sentence before it.

Shared code is in recipes/output/machine-configuration/_machine.py. It saves a 3-axis Machine "Shop Router" with the linuxcnc Post in the asset folder and makes a Job with a Profile and a Drilling Operation on the drilling-1 model.

Two recipes do not use the standard procedure. Examine them:

1. editor-kinematics-rotation-strategy.py does not use shot.widget(). The open list is a window of its own, and shot.widget(dialog) does not include it. The recipe captures the area of the dialog from the screen with QScreen.grabWindow, writes shot.out and sets shot.saved. A shot method for a dialog with an open list would remove this code from the recipe.

2. editor-validation-dialog.py replaces QMessageBox.exec_ with QMessageBox.show for the capture. The Validate button calls box.exec_() in validate_current_machine(), which stops the capture. With the replacement, the recipe clicks the real Validate button and captures the real message box. The recipe also selects the linuxcnc Post on the Postprocessor tab first. Without a Post, a new Machine gives two errors (no axes, empty postprocessor_file_name) and one warning. The first attempt showed this state and was corrected.

The details area of the Validation dialog has its default size, so the warning line wraps to two lines.

The width is 400 for the three Machine Editor and dialog figures and for the Post-Processing Dialog, and 600 for the Job task panel.

Nothing was committed. Changed or new: the page, manifest.yml, five images in images/output/machine-configuration/, and six files in images/recipes/output/machine-configuration/.
